title: Create a Slack reminder with AI for the time you mean
h1: turn a request into a slack reminder
description: Have a bot create a Slack reminder with your exact text and time. Check who receives it and why reminders for another person may be unavailable.
answer: a bot can create a slack reminder from the words you want to see and the time you want it to appear. the time can be a natural-language request, including a recurring schedule. unless you name someone else, it reminds your connected user. this is a write in dusk, so the sending setting does not make reminder creation ask you first.
og_line: a reminder with a clear recipient.
what:
this saves the reminder in slack rather than leaving a to-do in your dusk conversation. text and time are required. you can ask for a one-off nudge or a repeating reminder, so a single creation can be enough for a repeating job.

name the person if you want to remind someone else. it may not be able to set reminders for teammates; the bot will tell you if it can't. for a personal reminder, leave the recipient unset rather than guessing another person.
uses: remind yourself to bring a product sample before the courier arrives
set a recurring personal nudge to submit your weekly expense claim
save a follow-up reminder after a conversation where you promised to check a delivery

routine.message: every friday at 16:00, look at the sample pickups i confirmed in this chat this week. for each one, show me a slack reminder for myself an hour before pickup, and ask me before you create them. never set reminders for anyone else or make the same reminder twice.
routine.needs: slack connected, read and write access to create reminders for your own user
routine.output:
proposed slack reminders

1. collect the frostmere samples, tuesday 13:15
2. collect the frostmere glaze kit, thursday 10:00

for you only. waiting for your ok.

steps: enable slack in **Connected apps** with **read and write**, narrowing the bot to reminder creation if that is its whole job.
write the exact reminder text and time. say explicitly whether it repeats and who should receive it.
test a reminder for yourself before trying any other recipient. put an ask-first instruction in the request when the saved schedule needs review.
check the first reminders in slack before leaving the routine running.
watch: if a teammate's reminder isn't allowed, the bot should tell you, not quietly remind you instead.
repeatedly creating a recurring reminder can leave you with duplicate nudges. schedule the creation once when one repeating reminder is the goal.

faq.q: can it remind a teammate instead of me?
faq.a: usually not. slack only lets some kinds of connection remind other people, and the bot will say if yours can't.

faq.q: do i need a dusk routine for every weekly reminder?
faq.a: no. this action accepts recurring natural-language times. a dusk routine can create the recurring slack reminder once, rather than creating a new reminder each week.
